issue_context.title: MQTT Exception in availability_message_received when handling msg.
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Since 2022.3 i think, i've been getting my home-assistant.log flooded with the following error message:
```
2022-03-17 20:15:21 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.util.logging] Exception in availability_message_received when handling msg on 'homeassistant/sensor/SAM-PC2/availability': 'online'
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/mqtt/debug_info.py", line 47, in wrapper
    msg_callback(msg)
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/mqtt/mixins.py", line 439, in availability_message_received
    payload = self._avail_topics[topic][CONF_AVAILABILITY_TEMPLATE](msg.payload)
KeyError: 'homeassistant/sensor/SAM-PC2/availability'
```

The MQTT topic is being published by the [HASS Workstation Service](https://github.com/sleevezipper/hass-workstation-service) 

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2022.3.5

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2022.2 I think

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

MQTT

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/mqtt

### Diagnostics information

Attached is the MQTT diagnostic information, as well as a home-assistant.log with homeassistant.core and homeassistant.components.mqtt set to debug logging.
[config_entry-mqtt-567807183ea8450ea83e2e842fdca6d5.json.txt](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/8285502/config_entry-mqtt-567807183ea8450ea83e2e842fdca6d5.json.txt)
[home-assistant.log](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/8285515/home-assistant.log)


### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
There are some other error messages that appear during startup (that are in the log files) but they seem to only appear one:

2022-03-17 17:58:30 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.util.logging] Exception in discovery_callback when dispatching 'mqtt_discovery_updated_('sensor', 'SAM-PC2 LastBootSensor')': ({'device_class': 'timestamp', 'icon': 'mdi:clock-time-three-outline', 'unique_id': '60047dce-4ca2-4eff-9929-15ba5b8d2566', 'device': {'identifiers': 'hass-workstation-serviceSAM-PC2', 'manufacturer': 'Sam', 'model': 'Microsoft Windows NT 10.0.19043.0', 'name': 'SAM-PC2', 'sw_version': '1.0.0.29957'}, 'name': 'LastBootSensor', 'state_topic': 'homeassistant/sensor/SAM-PC2/LastBootSensor/state', 'platform': 'mqtt'},)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/mqtt/mixins.py", line 571, in discovery_callback
    await self._discovery_update(payload)
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/mqtt/mixins.py", line 747, in discovery_update
    await self._subscribe_topics()
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/mqtt/sensor.py", line 317, in _subscribe_topics
    await subscription.async_subscribe_topics(self.hass, self._sub_state)
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/mqtt/subscription.py", line 125, in async_subscribe_topics
    for sub in sub_state.values():
RuntimeError: dictionary changed size during iteration
```
```


### Additional information

_No response_
comments:
Hey there @emontnemery, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`mqtt`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L630) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

---

[mqtt documentation](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/mqtt)
[mqtt source](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/tree/dev/homeassistant/components/mqtt)
<sub><sup>(message by IssueLinks)</sup></sub>

I'm not sure if this helps or confuses things futher, but I updated to Home Assistant OS 7.5 this morning, and so far today I haven't had any more of those errors.  I can't think what the relationship is between HA OS and MQTT, so I do wonder if its some sort of race condition / timing, and with a full reboot from an OS update the timing sorted itself out.
It might be needed to add a guard to the MQTT subscriptions, as it seems it could be changed while processing subscriptions.
Fixed by https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/68785, thanks a lot @sam-ward for including logs and diagnostics 👍

> Fixed by #68785, thanks a lot @sam-ward for including logs and diagnostics 👍

Glad I could help :-). Thanks for the prompt fix.

review_comments: async_added_to_hass is overrided called from sensor and binary_sensor. These overrides should process the restore before calling super().async_added_to_hass
It might be async_added_to_hass is also called when a config_entry is added.
This seems no issue since `self.async_send_discovery_done()` is not doing anything when the entity is restored, only when it is discovered.
The MQTT entities are only added when they are discovered.
